summary.text: Generating a natural 40-80 message conversation with time and date constraints while reconciling restaurant venue details from prior memory.
Verifying speaker label rules and message count while aligning venue and time facts.
Clarifying pronoun usage for the Me label and proceeding with JSON formatting.

content.text:
{
  "dialogue": "Maya: ugh finally on the couch
Me: same, long day?
Maya: so long, my laptop was being weird all afternoon
Me: oh no, did it crash again?
Maya: almost, I had like 20 tabs open oops
Me: classic, that's why it hates you
Maya: lol fair, I closed them all and it forgave me
Me: what'd you end up having for dinner?
Maya: just heated up some soup, you?
Me: leftover pasta, very gourmet
Maya: honestly soup + pasta weather now
Me: right? it's finally feeling like fall in the evenings
Maya: yes, I had my window open and actually got chilly
Me: same, I had to grab a blanket
Maya: okay so random but I was just looking at menus
Me: oh for tomorrow?
Maya: yeah, I was checking Luigi's and I was like wait why are the prices so different
Me: Luigi's? lol
Maya: yeah I had their margherita tab open and got confused for a sec
Maya: then I realized I'm dumb, that's not even where we're going
Me: haha where did Luigi's come from?
Maya: I think I googled pizza near Oak and it popped up
Me: oh gotcha
Maya: yeah no, we're still on for Rosa's on Oak Street at 12:30 tomorrow right?
Me: yes! 12:30 at Rosa's, that's the plan
Maya: good, cause I was staring at Luigi's menu like where are the garlic knots
Me: lol they could never
Maya: seriously, Rosa's knots are the whole point
Me: exactly, half order to start?
Maya: you know it, half order so we save room
Me: got it, I'll grab us a table again
Maya: yes please, hopefully patio if it's not too cold
Me: I'll check, I can do a chair safety test again
Maya: lol please, your official job
Me: are you wfh tomorrow?
Maya: yeah, so I can just walk over like last time
Me: nice, I'm in office but I'll slip out
Maya: still good for like an hour-ish?
Me: yeah probably an hour, hour and a half, should be fine
Maya: perfect, plenty of knot time
Me: how's the basil doing btw?
Maya: still alive! I'm shocked
Me: no way, miracle basil lives on
Maya: don't jinx it, I'm actually watering it now
Me: proud plant parent moment
Maya: lol trying, how are yours?
Me: a little droopy, I need to water them tonight actually
Maya: go do it after we stop texting
Me: I will, promise
Maya: did you ever send me that baking show name?
Me: oh no you were supposed to send me!
Maya: wait was I? I thought you were watching it
Maya: nooo I never got the name, the mop cake one
Me: oh right! yeah you never sent it
Maya: ugh sorry, let me find it, it's still in my history
Me: yes please, need background noise for folding laundry
Maya: lol you're actually folding tonight?
Me: maybe... it's currently chair decor again
Maya: see, we both have the chair system
Me: it's the only system that works
Maya: okay found it, I'll send after this episode ends
Me: perfect, no rush
Maya: are you doing pottery next week again?
Me: yeah Tuesday, you wanna come with your sister sometime?
Maya: maybe in october, she's still saying someday
Me: tell her Tuesday guy is waiting lol
Maya: I will, my wavy bowl aspirations are low tho
Me: that's the charm, trust me
Maya: if you say so, I'm so bad at that stuff
Me: mine holds keys now, that's success
Maya: functional art, I respect it
Me: anyway, I'm excited for tomorrow, I need real pizza
Maya: same, soup was fine but not pizza",
  "writer_note": "Kept the evening couch tone to fit the 7-9pm window and used the menu mix-up to surface Luigi's then reconfirm Rosa's on Oak Street at 12:30 for tomorrow (Friday) without changing the venue."
}
